text:
Nia: Hey team — large enterprise (healthcare vertical) asked for an on‑prem POC in a sealed network. They want details on packaging, upgrade cadence, and pricing tiers. They also attached a 40‑page security questionnaire. Can we align response and blockers?

Owen: Thanks. Do we know whether they need USB media or can accept a controlled jumpbox/airgap pull?

Luis: Customer here — prefer physical media (sneakernet) for initial deploy, then push delta bundles via a vetted staging host. Need CVE patch windows no more than 30 days.

Marina: Noted. Two immediate things: (1) we can produce minibundles for hotfixes (delta patching), but checksum/signing flow and HSM integration required; (2) upgrade cadence is configurable, but airgapped customers usually pick monthly security cadence + quarterly feature rollups.

Kevin: For pricing — sealed/offline POCs have a one‑time packaging fee + premium per‑month support for signed bundles and concierge transfer. I'll pull numbers but expect ~1.15x on top of standard Dedicated pricing for the first 6 months.

Sarah: Legal needs to confirm data handling and export controls. Also the customer questionnaire has a question about supply‑chain attestations for the signed bundle. We need a proposed answer for: "Do you provide SBOM and signing key provenance?"

Owen: For SBOM we can provide a component manifest for the delivered bundle and a Notary signature. We can't share KMS private key material; we can provide an HSM attestation statement and signer cert chain. Suggested answer: yes — SBOM and signer certificate chain provided; private keys remain with Redwood and signing performed in HSM with audit logs.

SecurityBot: Incident policy / FYI — airgapped bundles must include reproducible build hashes and a signed manifest. See internal playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/airgap-signing

Marina: Operational constraints: media size — default full bundle ~12GB compressed; minibundles typically <250MB. If customer has strict USB/airdrop limits we'll need to shard the bundle and provide chunk checksums + reassembly tool (we've done this before).

Luis: Can you confirm chunk SHA256 workflow? We need something our compliance team can verify offline.

Owen: Example command for chunking and signing we can give them:

```
# split + sha256 + sign
split -b 500M redwood_bundle.tar.gz part_ && for f in part_*; do sha256sum $f >> parts.sha256; done
redwood_sign_tool sign --manifest parts.sha256 --out signed_manifest.sig
```

Marina: Also callout: offline certificate rotation — we support offline rekeying but it requires a signed rotation bundle delivered via same transport and a maintenance window. Recommend customers schedule rotation windows quarterly.

Sarah: For the questionnaire answer on key provenance: propose: "Signing keys are stored in FIPS 140‑2 level 3 HSMs. We provide a signer cert chain and signed manifests; private key material never leaves HSM. We can provide an HSM attestation and audit logs under NDA."

Kevin: Sales ask: do we have a standard line item for 'bundle chunking + USB staging' in the quote template? If not, I'll add an SOW item and estimate 12‑16 engineering hours + packaging fee.

Marina: We don't have a canned SKU for chunking. Ops usually bills it as Professional Services. ETA for engineering prep: 3 business days for minibundle + signing automation, 7 days for full offline-runbook + chunker testing.

Nia: OK — plan: Kevin to draft quote with packaging fee and PS hours; Sarah to prepare legal language for SBOM/HSM attestation; Owen + Marina to author a succinct ops-runbook and byte‑level chunk verification commands for the customer. I'll consolidate and push a response to the customer by EOD tomorrow. @Luis any blockers from your side?

Luis: ETA from our compliance team is 48 hours once we get the SBOM + signer cert. No other blockers. Thanks. :pray:

Owen: One more gotcha — licensing: offline deployments require license activation tokens that the customer must import offline. We provide a token generator + activation instructions. Add that to the runbook.

Marina: Adding that now. Also including fallback policy: if a security hotfix is critical and customer can't accept delta in <7 days, we offer emergency signed hotfix channel (extra cost) or can do a remote assisted install under an approved gateway for an additional support fee.

Kevin: I'll model emergency channel as a monthly premium in the quote.

Nia: Great work. I'll assemble reply and tag people in the response thread. If anyone has anything to add, post here.

Marina: Uploading a minimal sample manifest and chunker script to the shared drive; will post link in reply.

SecurityBot: Reminder: attach redacted audit logs only. Don't post private key info in this channel."
